شَرِيعٌ Courageous; (O, K, TA;) applied to a man. (O, TA.) ＝
-A2- Also Good, or excellent, flax. (K.) ―
-b2- And The ليف [or fibres that grow at the base of the branches of the palm-tree] of which the prickles (شَوْك) are strong, and such as, by reason of their thickness, are fit for the sewing of leather therewith. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
